description: This PHP source file serves as a web page for troubleshooting logs within a network gateway management interface. It includes necessary header files, handles user interface for filtering log types and time frames, and dynamically loads and displays system, event, and firewall logs via AJAX. The script also provides options for printing and downloading the logs.

methods.name: adjust_acs_tb
methods.description: Reformats a table to include proper headers and summaries for accessibility.

methods.name: ajaxDo
methods.description: Performs an AJAX request to fetch logs based on mode and timeframe, then populates the corresponding table and manages pagination.
